sm_top.sm: Iran reports another tanker was hit by a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz.
An Israeli strike hit Nasser Hospital in Gaza, killing six people.
Russian strikes kill one person in Zaporizhzhia and two in Odesa.
A Ukrainian drone struck a Russian warship in the Baltic Sea.
China sent 100 warships near Taiwan in a blockade rehearsal.
Drones launched an attack on the Samara Oil Transfer Station in Russia.
Reports claimed Iran targeted a US radar system in Bahrain, while US forces intercepted incoming drones.
Ukraine launched nearly 1,200 drones at Russia.
Moscow launched a strike targeting a hospital in central Kyiv, while Ukrainian officials reported ongoing Starshield restrictions.
Anadolu reported that Israel has carried out 793 attacks on health services in Gaza since October 2023, resulting in 1,725 health worker deaths.
Yemeni government forces fortified Aden as Houthi fighters advanced and encircled the city.
At least 44 civilians were killed in ADF attacks in Ituri province between November 9 and 12, following earlier attacks in North Kivu.
An Israeli airstrike hit Nasser Hospital in Khan Yunis, killing a doctor and several others.
Military Watch Magazine reports an Iranian strike destroyed a US early warning radar in Bahrain.
Ukrainian Air Force reported an overnight attack by 96 Russian drones, of which 81 were shot down or suppressed by air defenses.
A deadly drone strike killed dozens of displaced civilians in Kiramu District, West Oromia.
An armed attack near the western border of Niger leaves at least 38 people dead.
Ukraine struck a major Russian oil refinery in Volgograd.
An attack near Téra in western Niger's Tillabéri region killed over 30 civilians, with local sources putting the death toll at 37.
Russia launched a large-scale drone attack on Ukraine while Kyiv struck targets inside Russia.
Iranian state media report a strike on the US Navy's 5th Fleet headquarters and release visual proof of a destroyed military asset.
Gunmen killed 37 civilians in Niger.
Ukraine's power grid faced fiercer Russian attacks heading into the winter.
An airstrike on the Byala IDP camp in Ponnagyun killed eight people and injured many others.
Pentagon approves permanent US base in Poland with 5,000 troops planned.
Africa CDC reported that IS-linked fighters killed 66 civilians in Ebola-hit eastern DR Congo.
Russian attacks left parts of 12 Ukrainian regions without power due to ongoing strikes.
Police identified 48 Ukrainians killed in a previous Russian airstrike on Komyshuvakha.
An attack attributed to an Islamic State-linked group in eastern DRC surpassed 60 deaths.
A drone scare at RAF Lakenheath in Britain prompted security forces to rush into action.
The Houthis launched ballistic missiles at Aden.
A car bomb explosion in Moscow injured an aide to a former pro-Russian Ukrainian politician.
The Houthis claimed a fresh attack targeting Riyadh Airport and a Saudi oil pipeline.
Drone attacks across Sudan have killed civilians and damaged power infrastructure, with the UN warning of humanitarian impact.
The Iranian military claimed to have shot down a U.S. MQ-1 drone off the southern coast of Iran.
US President Trump stated he might use military action against Cuba before leaving office.
The Houthis claimed a missile strike on Saudi forces in Jazan.
A German drone system supplied to Ukraine was targeted by a cyberattack, forcing the suspension of military flight operations for its aircraft.
Security forces recaptured a national stadium from gang control in Haiti.
ICC judges close a part of the Afghanistan investigations that could have examined US troops.
